title: Typing
explain: Type hints say what types a function expects and returns, but Python does not enforce them at runtime. Tools like `mypy` and your editor read them to catch mistakes before you run the code. They also work as documentation for whoever reads the code next.
exercise: Add type hints to a function that takes a name and a list of scores and returns the average.
tip: Hints are not checks. Passing the wrong type still runs until something breaks, so run `mypy` to find those problems.
